notes: All 25 candidates are individual in-memoriam (obituary) notices on the Caltech Alumni Association site (alumni.caltech.edu/in-memoriam/...), each captured once in 2016. Twenty-one give only the deceased's name and Caltech degree years (some with an external obituary link), with no field, placement or list of graduates. Four carry obituary text that states the degree field and career: Kenneth G. Wilson (physics PhD '61), Halton C. Arp (astronomy PhD '53), Seung-Man Yang (chemical engineering PhD '85, KAIST faculty from 1985) and Allen E. Puckett (aeronautics PhD '49, Hughes Aircraft from 1949); all four are outside operations/management, so they are classified not-a-list rather than single-record. Three URLs are duplicates of the same Lionel Jaffe notice. No page lists program graduates or placements; nothing to integrate. Institution by host (California Institute of Technology) is correct for every page.
